facts.claim: There were 245 pupils at the schools established at Vfrdjpet, Kiggatndd and Fraserpet.
facts.quote: established at Vfrdjpet, Kiggatndd and Fraserpet with a total of 245 pupils are to serve a double purpose.

facts.claim: The opening of two more schools at Padyndlkandd and Kodlipet will give each taluq an English school.
facts.quote: With the opening of two more Schools at Padyndlkandd and Kodlipet, each taluq will have an English School.

facts.claim: The first decisive step was taken in 1862 when the Coorg Headmen petitioned the Government for assistance.
facts.quote: the first decisive step having been taken in 1862, when the Coorg Headmen petitioned Government for assistance.
